subject: Draft MAP + evaluation checklist and risk diligence
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@brightair.ai>, Sophie Lin <sophie.lin@brightair.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP + evaluation checklist (BrightAir)

Hi Alex / Sophie,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — really enjoyed the conversation and the use cases you outlined for inference at scale. As promised, I'm attaching a lightweight MAP template and a short evaluation checklist to help structure the next 6 weeks. The MAP is intentionally concise so we can align stakeholders quickly and lock on the technical gates.

High-level ask: can you review the MAP and the proposed weekly gates, then let us know which stakeholders should own each gate? If you're good with the structure, we'll populate dates and deliverables and share a paired calendar.

Attachments: MAP-template-v1.gdoc (gd link in next mail), risk-diligence-sheet.xlsx (stub)

Proposed cadence (example):
- Week 0: Kickoff + entitlement/roles (1 hr)
- Week 1: Integration spike + perf baseline (engineer owners)
- Week 2: Early evaluation (business owners + quality checks)
- Week 3: Cost/runbook review + SLA gating
- Week 4: Acceptance checklist and pilot sign-off

I've looped Marissa (CS) and Priya (solutions) to help with the acceptance criteria and security checklist. Once we have preferred owners/dates from your side I'll push a first-pass GDoc and slide deck.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: MAP-template-v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub)
Attachment: risk-diligence-sheet.xlsx (Excel stub, contains SOC2 questions + data flow)

From: Alex Torres <atorres@brightair.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Lin <sophie.lin@brightair.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + evaluation checklist (BrightAir)

Connor,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the template — this looks good and pragmatic. A couple of quick notes from our side:

- Stakeholder owners: I'll own the cost/runbook gate, Sophie will own the perf baseline (she's our infra lead), and I'll loop our security contact for the SOC2/data-retention items (likely provisionally next Tues).
- Timeline preference: we'd prefer a compact 4-week pilot (compress week 1 & 2 activities where feasible).
- Risk diligence: can you add a short inventory of what logs we can expect to see in the audit trail and any PII handling notes in the risk sheet? Procurement will need that when we scope the PO.

Also — would you mind including a 2-slide summary (1: MAP + owners, 2: key acceptance criteria) for our internal execs?

If you can update the doc, I'll circulate with Sophie and our security lead.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Torres | Head of Platform Engineering
BrightAir
atorres@brightair.ai

Subject: Re: Draft MAP + evaluation checklist (BrightAir)

Thanks Alex — great notes. I've compressed the MAP into a 4-week plan and added an explicit audit-log inventory and PII-handling notes to the risk sheet (see attachments). I also drafted the 2-slide summary (attached as slides stub) so you have something succinct for exec syncs.

Highlights of the updated MAP (summary):
- Compact 4-week pilot: Week 0 kickoff, Week 1 integration & perf baseline, Week 2 early evaluation + quality, Week 3 acceptance + cost/runbook review.
- Owners: Alex (cost/runbook), Sophie (perf baseline), Redwood lead (Connor) coordinates weekly check-ins.
- Acceptance criteria: latency within agreed baseline, end-to-end inference correctness on supplied test prompts, pass on security checklist items in the risk sheet.

Links: Updated MAP doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MapTemplate_example (edit access: brightair@brightair.ai)
Slides (2-slide summary): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1MapSlides_example

Attachments: MAP-template-v1.gdoc (updated), risk-diligence-sheet.xlsx (updated), MAP-pitch-slides-v1.gslides (stub)

Next steps: if this looks good I'll lock calendar invites for the kickoff (30 minutes) and drop the final MAP into a shared folder. Marissa, Priya — anything you want to add to acceptance criteria before I send the formal invite?

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com

Connor / Priya —

This reads well. I made three small edits in the GDoc: clarified the acceptance test owner for data-quality metrics, tightened the rollback criteria, and added an explicit handover note for weekly status emails to procurement. I also tweaked the slides for exec clarity (slide 2: acceptance bullets -> bold).

I'm happy for you to send the updated MAP to Alex/Sophie and lock the kickoff for next Tuesday at 10am PT (tentative). Connor — please attach the final GDoc link and include the procurement contact in the invite (procurement@brightair.ai).
